description.text: This discipline attaches great importance to academic exchanges and actively carries out international academic exchanges and cooperation. Well-known foreign experts and scholars are often invited to give lectures at the school, and experts and professors are often invited to visit and give lectures abroad, and young teachers are sent abroad for further study. In recent years, it has become increasingly active in exchange visits and academic activities with scholars from France, Canada, the United States, Japan, Germany and other countries. It has maintained close cooperative relations and regular personnel exchanges with well-known foreign universities such as Lille University of Science and Technology, Vanache University, Klaimon-Ferrand University, Kyoto University in Japan, Nagoya Institute of Technology, Berlin University of Applied Sciences in Germany, University of Pittsburgh in the United States, Chunti University in the Netherlands, etc., and sends visiting scholars and advanced students to each other. Extensive academic exchanges and cooperation enable the discipline to timely learn from and absorb advanced technological achievements and school-running experience at home and abroad, which plays a very important role in accelerating the pace of discipline construction, improving the academic level and self-quality of teachers, and making the quality of talent training in this discipline, and at the same time expanding the prestige of the international academic community.

duration.text: The Civil Engineering at China Three Gorges University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 200 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2083 USD/per year ￥ 15000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Scanned copy of valid ordinary passport (personal information page). 2. Notarized highest diploma or degree certificate issued directly by university with official stamp and signature; Documents in languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with notarized Chinese or English translations. 3. Academic transcripts of the highest diploma (Transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with notarized Chinese or English translations.); 4. A Study Plan or Research Proposal (written in Chinese or English); 5. Two Recommendation Letters signed by professors or associate professors for postgraduate programs applicants. (written in Chinese or English); 6. A 3-5 minutes video clip to introduce yourself in English or Chinese. (Please send the video named by the passport number and your full name to our official email) 7. Non-Criminal Record Certificate. 8. Foreigner Physical Examination Form valid within 6 months (photocopy). 9. The copy of valid HSK Certificate or English level certificate if have; 10. Financial Support Statement should be provided by the Local Government Scholarship Applicants & Self-support applicants 11. Other documents (Title Lists of Published Papers or Introductions of Research programs)

requirements.text: 1. Foreign citizenship with valid passport. Note: The applicants should hold the valid foreign passport or nationality certificate more than 4 years. In the latest 4 years (up to April 30 of the enrollment year), the applicants lived in a foreign country more than 2 years (the actual living abroad for more than 9 months in a year can be counted as one year, subject to the entry and exit stamps). 2. Chinese Friendly; good physical and mental health; hardworking; academically excellent. 3. The requirements for applicants’ degree and age are that applicants must: （1）be a holder of high school diploma or its equivalent under the age of 25 when applying for an undergraduate program; （2）be a holder of a Bachelor’s degree or its equivalent under the age of 35 when applying for a Master’s program; （3）be a holder of a Master’s degree or its equivalent under the age of 40 when applying for a doctoral program;
